name: AETHA
description: A modular Geometry Dash utility suite with a customizable interface and frame telemetry.

counter-enabled.name: Enable AETHA Counter
counter-enabled.description: Show the AETHA telemetry overlay during gameplay.

counter-show-ticks.name: Show Update Tick Count
counter-show-ticks.description: Show the number of PlayLayer update calls since the level started.

counter-refresh-ms.name: Counter Refresh Interval
counter-refresh-ms.description: How often the displayed telemetry is refreshed.

theme-accent.name: Interface Accent
theme-accent.description: Accent color reserved for the upcoming customizable AETHA interface.
